text: あいたい　あのひとが　いない！

structure.jp: あいたい　あのひとが
structure.en: that person I want to see

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means 'want to do' it. あいたい = 'want to meet'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: あいたい　あのひと
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes it, like 'the person that...' in English. あいたい あのひと = 'that person I want to see'.
